text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Padagis US LLC scopolamine transdermal system is listed on the FDA shortage list as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-11-03. Our current on‑hand supply across three sites ranges from 10 to 17 days at present usage rates. Corvale East has 89 units (10.4 days), Corvale General has 127.43 units (14.8 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 38 units (17 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Padagis US LLC scopolamine transdermal system as To Be Discontinued since 2025-11-03. The product label in our system names Zydus Lifesciences Limited as the labeler and plant (FEI 3008957483) for NDC 70771178704. FDA inspection records for that FEI show a VAI classification on 2013-09-21 (known 2014-03-05) and another VAI on 2024-07-19 (known 2024-09-30).

Our position: The Padagis product is slated for discontinuation. Inventory is critically low. Alternative suppliers are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their labels do not identify a plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with A-S Medication Solutions, Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC, Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Bryant Ranch Prepack, and Ingenus Pharmaceuticals, LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to request plant identification and supply reliability data from each alternative supplier; requires Quality Assurance review.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes; requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further FDA updates given current days‑on‑hand.
